answer_1.quote: Equipped with CLAIMDECOMP dataset, we train a model to generate decompositions of complex political claims. We experiment with pre-trained sequence-to-sequence models, generating either a sequence of questions or a single question using nucleus sampling over multiple rounds.

answer_2.quote: We also explored an automated method for assessing whether generated questions match ground truth ones. We aim to define a metric m(q, q) that compares the two sets of generated questions. Instead, we rely on existing scoring functions that can compare single strings, like ROUGE and BERTScore.

answer_4.quote: One of the authors evaluated the recall of each annotated subquestion in the generated subquestion set.
answer_4.guideline: recall of each annotated subquestion in the generated subquestion set
